Feature: Is ergative alignment of flagging conditioned by any other factor?
curated_comment: No source reference. Value 0 (no conditioning) may be debatable: personal pronouns do NOT take ERG or ABS in Limbu (Van Driem 1987:26), constituting a pronoun/NP conditioning of ergative marking. If ERGON defines "conditioning" as including the pronoun exception, value should be 1. Researcher should verify coding criteria. Source for pronoun behaviour: Van Driem 1987:26.

Feature: Are the ergative and the genitive expressed by the same marker?
curated_comment: Original value 0 is incorrect. Van Driem (1987:34) explicitly lists ergative <-?ille, -le>, instrumental <-?ille, -le>, and genitive <-?ille, -le> as the same morpheme. The ERG suffix -le/-re and GEN suffix -re are allomorphs of a single oblique marker — a well-documented feature of Tibeto-Burman languages. Corrected to 1. Source: Van Driem 1987:34.

Feature: Are the ergative and the instrumental/comitative expressed by the same marker?
curated_comment: Original value 0 is incorrect. Van Driem (1987:34) explicitly lists ergative <-?ille, -le> and instrumental <-?ille, -le> as the same morpheme (along with genitive). Corrected to 1. Source: Van Driem 1987:34.
